tei:div.tei:p: rang gter gy-i phag mo'i sgrub thabs 'bri ba'i skabs su shog tshad ci 'dra zhig yin snyam nas yod skabs nyams snang la bud med mdzes ma zhig 'ongs nas 'di skad zer/ khyod kyi zab gter gyi shog tshad nga rang gis shes zer/ bdag gis nga bdag pos mi shes pa zhig khyod kyis mi shes smras pas/ yang de na re/ khyod gter la dbang yang gdos bcas kyi sbubs su gnas pas zag med kyi mkhyen cha chung*/ nga lus med 'od du snang bas gang shar thams cad rten 'brel brda chos su ston nus zer/ yang bdag gis 'on 'di mkha' 'gro'i sprul pa zhig yin par 'dug snyam nas smras pa/ bdag gis zag bcas zag med zer ba de mi shes/ shog tshad ji yin ma go bas de'i don khyod kyis smos dang smras pas/ de ma thag tu gzugs mi snang bar skad snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad zer/ e e: chos dbyings mtha' bral kyi klong nas: gang snang ye shes kyi rol pa ngoms: ma skyes rang byung gi ḍā ki ma: nga mi min bde ba'i go cha yin: khyod ma yengs sgra 'dzin dbang po gson: chos thams cad rten cing 'brel pa la: thabs mkhas pas snang ba brda ru ston: gter dpe yi shog tshad rnam bzhi yod: dbyings mi 'gyur chos sku'i mkha' klong nas: mdangs ma 'gags ye shes cir yang 'char: mi 'jigs bzhi ma 'dres bco 32) brgyad dang: tshad med bzhi'i mtshon pa'i rtags su shes: de bde gshegs 'dus pa'i shog tshad lags: chos stong nyid bco brgyad phar phyin drug: mtshon pa'i rtags su shes pa ni: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i shog tshad lags: 'phags lam brgyad dang rnam thar brgyad: bsdu dngos bzhi mtshon rtags su shes: stong chen mkha' 'gro'i shog tshad lags: theg pa brgyad dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi'i: brda mtshon 'di ni man ngag bka' srung ngo : de dag dbyibs legs gru bzhir 'khyil: chos dbyings mtha' bzhi'i dri bral brda: de ltar gong 'og ma nyams par: rig pas dpyod dang gsal bar nges:
